content.value_statement: Complex AI projects often need several skills, checkpoints, and validation steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured Antigravity workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes common requests to SaaS MVP, web security audit, AI agent, or browser QA workflows.
Guides agents to propose one or two matching workflows before execution.
Requires step-by-step execution with current step announcements and expected artifacts.
Defines completion reporting with artifacts, validation evidence, remaining risks, and next actions.
Adds guardrails for destructive actions, missing skills, and authorized security testing.
limitations: Referenced workflow source files are not included in the reviewed package.
It orchestrates other skills and does not replace specialized implementation skills.
It depends on local availability of referenced Antigravity skills.
It cannot guarantee results without environment access, credentials, or required infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS MVP delivery
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into a guided plan, build, test, and release sequence with concrete artifacts.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a web security review
use_cases.description: Select a security audit workflow and keep authorization, findings, and validation evidence explicit.

use_cases.title: Stabilize browser automation work
use_cases.description: Use a QA workflow to organize test triage, browser automation steps, and completion criteria.
use_cases.target_user: QA engineers and full stack developers

prompt_templates.title: Choose a workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use antigravity-workflows to review my goal and suggest the one or two best workflows before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Run an MVP workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use antigravity-workflows to run a SaaS MVP workflow for my project idea. Show each step, artifact, and validation checkpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a security audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Authorized review of a web application
prompt_templates.prompt: Use antigravity-workflows to execute a web app security audit workflow. Confirm scope and authorization before any testing step.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a multi-skill release
prompt_templates.prompt: Use antigravity-workflows to coordinate planning, implementation, browser QA, and release validation. If a required skill is missing, state the gap and choose the closest safe fallback.

output_examples.input: I need to build and ship a small B2B SaaS prototype.
output: Recommended workflow: Ship a SaaS MVP.
Next artifact: a scoped milestone checklist with build, test, and release steps.
Validation: each step must produce evidence before moving forward.

output_examples.input: Audit my web app and summarize the security risks.
output: Recommended workflow: Security Audit for a Web App.
First checkpoint: confirm authorization, target scope, and excluded systems.
Final report: completed tests, findings, validation evidence, and open risks.

output_examples.input: Our browser tests are flaky before release.
output: Recommended workflow: QA and Browser Automation.
Step focus: reproduce failures, isolate causes, stabilize tests, and document evidence.
Completion criteria: passing validation run and a remaining risk log.

best_practices: Start with a clear objective, scope, and success criteria before choosing a workflow.
Require one concrete artifact and validation result for every workflow step.
Confirm authorization before security testing and approval before destructive actions.
anti_patterns: Skipping workflow selection and invoking unrelated skills without a plan.
Moving to the next step before the current artifact is validated.
Treating orchestration guidance as a substitute for required domain skills or credentials.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an agent choose and run structured Antigravity workflows for complex multi-step projects.

faq.question: Does it implement the project by itself?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates steps and referenced skills, but specialized skills perform domain-specific work.

faq.question: Which workflows are described?
faq.answer: The skill routes requests for SaaS MVP delivery, web security audits, AI agent systems, and browser QA.

faq.question: Can it run security testing automatically?
faq.answer: It requires explicit authorization before security testing and should keep scope clear.

faq.question: What happens if a required skill is missing?
faq.answer: The playbook tells the agent to state the gap and fall back to the closest available skill.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
